title: Fix Invalid Lowpoly Show-Edges Icon Id
description: lowpoly/plugin/rs/lib.rs used icon_id "git-commit-horizontal" for the "show edges" wireframe toggle (in lowpoly_window_engagement's WindowEngagementOption and in lowpoly_window_measures' WindowMeasure::Toggle), but that name has no entry in ui/asset/icon/generated/icon_name.rs's IconName catalog (only "git-commit" exists). The &str -> IconName From impl's .expect("invalid catalog icon name") panics at runtime whenever this code path builds, failing lowpoly-plugin tests: __semio_plugin_sanity_declared_apps_appear_in_bundle_manifest, engagement_options_contain_no_utility_switcher, paint_utility_params_are_utility_tagged_and_mesh_op_measures_removed, select_window_options_mirror_puzzle3d_taxonomy, window_kind_actions_scope_mesh_ops_to_main_only. Fix by swapping to an existing valid catalog icon that fits the wireframe/show-edges semantic, then verify with cargo test -p lowpoly-plugin.
summary: Fixed 3 invalid IconName catalog references in lowpoly/plugin/rs/lib.rs that caused runtime panics ("invalid catalog icon name") whenever the affected UI paths built: "git-commit-horizontal" → "grid-3x3" (show-edges wireframe toggle, 2 sites: WindowEngagementOption and WindowMeasure::Toggle), "cursor" → "mouse-pointer" (default selection mode toggle), "refresh-cw" → "arrow-right-left" (invertive selection mode toggle). Also swept the whole file's icon_id/icon usages against ui/asset/icon/generated/icon_name.rs's IconName catalog to confirm no other invalid names remain. Verified with `cargo test -p lowpoly-plugin`: all 20 unit tests pass, including the 5 originally-failing tests (__semio_plugin_sanity_declared_apps_appear_in_bundle_manifest, engagement_options_contain_no_utility_switcher, paint_utility_params_are_utility_tagged_and_mesh_op_measures_removed, select_window_options_mirror_puzzle3d_taxonomy, window_kind_actions_scope_mesh_ops_to_main_only). The lib doctest failure (E0463 can't find crate lowpoly_core) is a pre-existing, unrelated rustdoc crate-resolution issue.
